split.definition: amendment 'common.data': fit part = validation timestamps below the 70% timestamp cut, selection part = the rest (hcpat_train.py / v78_train.py: uts = unique(ts of the validation rows); cut = uts[int(0.7*len(uts))])

tkgl-polecat.note: valid_hist.npz['rows'] == valid_sample_idx.npy (checked); cut identical over the sample and over all 533,472 valid rows (329 unique ts)

adaptation: CountTRuCoLa released code and released config unchanged (same repo commit 5d9aedf, same DATASET_OVERRIDES, NUM_CPUS as before). A wrapper moves the validation facts with timestamp < cut (both directions, as CountTRuCoLa's dataset contains inverse quads) from the TGB val mask to the train mask in memory before RuleDataset indexes them; the val split then holds only the selection window. Rule examples, rule set and confidence-function parameters are therefore learned on train + validation fit window. Application history (union of all splits, t' < t) is unchanged; z-/f-rule statistics follow the released code on the modified splits.
interpretation_polecat: For tkgl-polecat the fit part is applied as ALL validation facts with ts < 1423 (372,024 rows), not only the 139,236 fit rows of the 200,000-row sample: CountTRuCoLa's learning treats every head fact absent from its train index as a negative example (closed world inside the train split), so adding only sampled facts would turn 62% of the true fit-window facts into false negatives. The cut (the split) is exactly the harness's. This gives CountTRuCoLa more fit-window label access than the HRcov ranker's capped 120,000 fit queries; declared as a deviation. For tkgl-smallpedia both readings coincide.
choices: No hyper-parameter or variant choice is made: settings are as released, so there is nothing to select on the selection part. Selection-part MRR/H@k are reported (harness selection rows: smallpedia 56,460; polecat 60,764 sample rows, plus all 161,448 polecat rows with ts >= cut, descriptive).
dumps: tracks/v78_external/dumps/counttrucola_adapted/<dataset>/{val,test}/, same format and harness query order as counttrucola; validation rows inside the learning data (ts < cut) carry in_learning_data=True and NaN scores/rr (no ranking is produced for them).
not_done: No HRcov comparison, no blend, no EdgeReMIND adapted.
